onde: Linha do tempo: capa de A Reforma; 1517
descricao: Wittenberg, Germany, October 1517: a German Augustinian monk in a black habit, about thirty-three years old, round face and tonsure, nailing a large sheet of paper to the heavy wooden door of the Castle Church, a few townspeople and students in early sixteenth-century clothing gathering to look, autumn leaves, late afternoon light; the writing on the sheet is illegible

onde: Linha do tempo: capa de O século pentecostal; 1906
descricao: Los Angeles, 1906: interior of a plain two-story wooden mission hall with rough plank benches and a pulpit made of stacked wooden crates; a humble African American pastor in a dark suit kneels in prayer beside the pulpit while a crowd of Black, white, Latino and Asian men and women in early 1900s clothing pray together with raised hands and joyful tears, warm light through dusty windows

onde: Linha do tempo: 1910–1911, Assembleia de Deus em Belém
descricao: Belém do Pará, Brazil, November 1910: two young Swedish men in simple dark suits and hats, each carrying one small suitcase and a Bible, stepping off a steamship gangway onto a busy tropical river port; mango trees, colonial Portuguese buildings with tiled facades, dock workers and market sellers, humid golden light over the wide Amazon estuary

onde: Linha do tempo: capa de Avivamentos e missões; 1738
descricao: England, 1740s: a slender Anglican clergyman in a black gown with white preaching bands and shoulder-length hair preaching outdoors from a small rise at dawn to a large crowd of coal miners with soot-covered faces, farm families and children, open fields and a mining village in the mist behind them

onde: Linha do tempo: 1681 e 1753, a Bíblia em português
descricao: Batavia on the island of Java, about 1680: a Portuguese Reformed pastor in his fifties wearing a black seventeenth-century coat with a plain white collar, writing with a quill at a wooden desk covered with open Hebrew, Greek and Latin Bibles and stacks of handwritten pages, tropical light through a shuttered window, palm trees and Dutch colonial rooftops outside

onde: Linha do tempo: capa de Do edito aos concílios; 325
descricao: Nicaea, AD 325: about three hundred bishops in simple late Roman tunics and cloaks seated in rows in a large imperial hall with marble columns, several of them with scars or a missing eye from past persecution, an open book of the Gospels resting on a central stand, one elderly bishop standing to speak, the emperor in purple seated quietly at the side

onde: Linha do tempo: capa de A igreja perseguida; culto dos primeiros cristãos
descricao: Second-century Rome: a small group of early Christians, men, women, slaves and a Roman matron side by side, gathered at night in a house courtyard lit by oil lamps, one elder reading aloud from a scroll while bread and a cup wait on a simple table, a child asleep on a mother's lap, faces attentive and peaceful

onde: Linha do tempo: capa de A Idade Média; c. 529
descricao: A medieval monastery scriptorium: Benedictine monks in dark habits seated at tall slanted desks beside arched windows, carefully copying large Bible manuscripts with quills, ink horns, pots of pigment and stacks of parchment, shelves of bound books, quiet morning light falling across the pages; the writing is illegible

onde: Linha do tempo: c. 1455
descricao: Mainz, Germany, about 1455: a bearded craftsman in a fur-trimmed cap lifting a freshly printed large page from a wooden screw printing press, an assistant inking metal type with leather ink balls, printed sheets hanging to dry on lines across the workshop, cases of movable type, candlelight and daylight mixed

onde: Linha do tempo: 1947, Manuscritos do Mar Morto
descricao: The cliffs of Qumran above the Dead Sea, 1947: a young Bedouin shepherd crouching inside a dry cave, carefully lifting the lid of a tall clay jar that holds ancient leather scrolls wrapped in linen, several other jars in the shadows, a shaft of sunlight from the cave mouth, the pale blue Dead Sea and desert hills visible outside

onde: Linha do tempo: Hoje, a Bíblia em milhares de línguas
descricao: A contemporary scene: people of many nations, an African grandmother, a Brazilian teenager, an Asian father with his daughter, an Indigenous Amazonian man, a European student, sitting together in a bright simple room, each reading the Bible in a different form: printed books, a phone, a tablet, a braille volume, warm natural light, joyful and attentive faces

onde: Linha do tempo: 70 d.C., Jerusalém é destruída
descricao: Jerusalem, AD 70: Roman legionaries with standards and siege towers breaking through the city walls while the great temple burns on the hill behind them, thick smoke rising into a red evening sky, seen from a distance on the Mount of Olives; no close-up violence

onde: Linha do tempo: 1526
descricao: A printing shop in Worms, Germany, 1526: an English scholar in his early thirties with a short beard and dark academic cap anxiously checking small freshly printed New Testaments while workers hide the books inside bales of cloth and sacks of grain for shipping, a narrow window showing a river barge waiting

onde: Linha do tempo: 1521–1534, a Bíblia em alemão
descricao: A small wood-paneled room in the Wartburg castle, winter 1521: a bearded man disguised as a knight in a plain dark doublet sits at a rough wooden table translating, a Greek New Testament open beside sheets of handwritten German, a tiled stove, snow-covered forest hills through the small window

onde: Linha do tempo: 1536
descricao: Geneva, about 1550: a thin French pastor with a long pointed beard, black gown and flat cap preaching from a raised wooden pulpit in the bare stone cathedral of Saint Pierre, an open Bible before him, townspeople, refugees and students with notebooks listening closely, plain white walls and tall Gothic windows

onde: Linha do tempo: c. 1382
descricao: England, about 1382: an elderly Oxford scholar with a long white beard and dark academic robe handing a hand-copied Bible to a group of barefoot preachers in plain russet gowns holding walking staffs, a rural parish church and muddy lane behind them, soft overcast light

onde: Linha do tempo: 1415
descricao: Prague, about 1410: a Czech priest in a simple black robe preaching earnestly from a wooden pulpit in the large plain Bethlehem Chapel, a huge crowd of ordinary townspeople, craftsmen and mothers with children packed on the floor listening, timber ceiling, daylight from high windows

onde: Linha do tempo: c. 382–405, a Vulgata
descricao: Bethlehem, about AD 400: an old lean scholar with a white beard in a rough monk's tunic writing by oil lamp in a cave-like stone study, Hebrew scrolls and Greek codices spread around him, a Jewish teacher seated beside him pointing to a line in a scroll, olive hills visible through the doorway at dusk

onde: Linha do tempo: 386–430
descricao: A walled garden in Milan, late summer AD 386: a North African man in his early thirties in a Roman tunic sitting under a fig tree with tears on his face, holding open a codex of Paul's letters, a friend watching from a bench in the background, dappled sunlight

onde: Linha do tempo: c. 155
descricao: The stadium of Smyrna, about AD 155: a very old white-bearded Christian bishop in a simple tunic standing calm and upright before a Roman proconsul seated on a raised tribunal, soldiers at his sides, a restless crowd in the stone seats, afternoon light; dignified, no violence shown

onde: Linha do tempo: 313, Edito de Milão
descricao: A Roman city street, AD 313: a herald on the steps of a basilica reading an imperial decree from a scroll while Christians of all ages embrace with relief and a workman reopens the doors of a house church that had been sealed, soldiers standing by peacefully, bright morning

onde: Linha do tempo: 367, os 27 livros
descricao: Alexandria, Egypt, AD 367: a short dark-skinned bishop with a reddish-gray beard dictating a letter to a scribe in a library room, a table before him holding a neat row of codices and scrolls of the Gospels and apostolic letters, the harbor lighthouse visible through the window

onde: Linha do tempo: 1611
descricao: England, about 1610: a company of scholars in black gowns and white ruff collars seated around a long oak table in a college library, comparing large open Bibles in Hebrew, Greek, Latin and earlier English versions, one reading aloud while the others follow and take notes, candlelight and leaded windows

onde: Linha do tempo: 1792
descricao: Serampore, Bengal, about 1805: an English missionary in his forties, balding, in a plain linen shirt and waistcoat, working at a desk with two Indian pundits in white dhotis, comparing manuscripts in several scripts, a wooden printing press and type cases behind them, palm trees and the Hooghly river through the veranda

onde: Linha do tempo: 1854–1892
descricao: London, 1860s: a stout bearded Baptist preacher in a black frock coat speaking from the railed platform of a vast Victorian tabernacle with two curved galleries, thousands of working-class and middle-class listeners filling every seat, gas lamps glowing

onde: Linha do tempo: 1855–1882, o evangelho no Brasil
descricao: Rio de Janeiro, about 1860: a Scottish physician-missionary and his wife leading a small Sunday school on the veranda of a modest house, Brazilian children and adults of different backgrounds seated on benches with open Bibles and hymn sheets, Sugarloaf mountain and the bay in the distance

onde: Linha do tempo: 1865
descricao: Inland China, about 1870: an English missionary dressed in a Chinese scholar's long blue gown and cap walking along a rice-field path beside a river with a Chinese evangelist, carrying a satchel of Scripture portions, a walled town and misty mountains ahead

onde: Linha do tempo: c. 1734–1743, o Grande Despertamento
descricao: Colonial America, 1740: a young clergyman in a black gown and white wig preaching with outstretched arms from a portable wooden field pulpit to an enormous open-air crowd of farmers, townspeople, enslaved people and Native Americans on a hillside, horses and wagons at the edges, dramatic clouds

onde: Linha do tempo: 1678
descricao: Bedford county jail, England, about 1670: a sturdy man with reddish hair and a mustache in plain Puritan clothes sitting on a stool in a stone cell writing by the light of a small barred window, a Bible on his knee, his blind young daughter visiting with a jug of soup

onde: Linha do tempo: 1525
descricao: Zurich, a winter evening in January 1525: a small group of young men and women in sixteenth-century Swiss clothing gathered in a candlelit house room, one kneeling while another pours water from a wooden ladle over his head in baptism, the rest praying, snow at the window

onde: Linha do tempo: 1054
descricao: Constantinople, 1054: the vast interior of the Hagia Sophia with golden mosaics, a group of Latin envoys in Western vestments walking out through the great doors while Greek clergy in Eastern robes stand at the altar watching in sorrow, shafts of light from the dome

onde: Linha do tempo: 332 a.C.
descricao: 332 BC: a young Macedonian king in bronze armor on horseback at the head of his phalanx approaching the walls of Jerusalem, where the high priest in white and gold garments and priests in white linen come out of the gate to meet him peacefully, Judean hills in spring

onde: Linha do tempo: c. 250 a.C.
descricao: Alexandria, Egypt, third century BC: Jewish scribes with beards and head coverings seated at tables in a colonnaded hall of the great library, translating Hebrew scrolls into Greek on fresh papyrus, shelves of scrolls behind them, the harbor and lighthouse visible beyond the columns

onde: Linha do tempo: 164 a.C.
descricao: The temple in Jerusalem, 164 BC: Jewish priests and fighters in simple armor relighting the great golden seven-branched lampstand in the cleansed sanctuary, others rebuilding the altar with uncut stones, families rejoicing with palm branches in the courtyard at dusk

onde: Linha do tempo: os Evangelhos; guia do NT (Lucas e Atos)
descricao: Luke the physician, a thoughtful Greek man in his forties with a short beard, sitting in a courtyard in Caesarea taking careful notes on a papyrus scroll while an elderly woman and two old Galilean fishermen tell him what they saw, a small case of medical instruments beside him, afternoon light

onde: Guia do NT: 2 Coríntios, Colossenses, 2 Tessalonicenses, Filemom, 2 e 3 João, Judas
descricao: A first-century house church in a Greek city: a traveling messenger still dusty from the road stands reading a letter scroll aloud by lamplight to a mixed gathering of believers, masters and slaves, women, children and elders seated on benches and mats in the atrium, listening intently

onde: Linha do tempo: Hebreus; guia do NT (capa de Hebreus)
descricao: The Day of Atonement in the ancient tabernacle: the Jewish high priest in plain white linen garments, holding a golden bowl and a censer with rising incense, about to pass through the heavy embroidered veil of blue, purple and scarlet into the Most Holy Place, golden light glowing from behind the curtain

onde: Linha do tempo: 1 Pedro; guia do NT (capa de 1 Pedro)
descricao: Rome, about AD 63: the apostle Peter, now an old sturdy fisherman with white curly hair and beard, dictating a letter in a modest upper room while Silvanus writes on a scroll and the younger Mark listens, an oil lamp on the table, the rooftops of Rome through the window at dusk

onde: Linha do tempo: João e suas cartas; guia do NT (1, 2 e 3 João)
descricao: Ephesus, about AD 90: the apostle John as a very old gentle man with long white hair and beard, seated in a chair in a courtyard, teaching a circle of younger believers and children who sit close around him, his hand raised in blessing, a scroll on his knees, evening light on marble columns

onde: Guia do NT: Apocalipse 4–5
descricao: A vision of heaven in symbolic style: a radiant throne surrounded by an emerald rainbow above a floor like a sea of glass, twenty-four elders in white robes laying golden crowns before it, and in the center a living Lamb standing, bearing the marks of sacrifice, beside a sealed scroll, countless worshipers of every nation stretching into the light; the one on the throne is shown only as brilliant light
